meta.units: fractions of viewport (x: 0 left → 1 right, y: 0 top → 1 bottom, Y DOWN)
meta.method: tight boxes: run-length filtered luminance profiles (writing T=222 verified by overlay, arch T=188, research T=195) + 2x/3x zoom crop reads; research cx corrected 0.815 -> 0.806
meta.note: Object boxes are GEOMETRIC edges (ribbon tip included in writing x0; shadows excluded — they are dark). R3F contact base must project to bottom; tops are geometry tops.

arc.shape: shallow SMILE (ends high, center low; centerLowY > sideY in screen coords)
arc.svg_note: percent units in 100x100 box, preserveAspectRatio=none; stroke fades at both ends; fit residual ~1.5% at branch ends — refit after render
